title: BGN bvychs at bv_comp 4.0: the level-compensation ladder continued above 2.5
question: Does the BGN fair gap keep rising with bv_comp above 2.5, or was 2.5 the peak of a non-monotone response?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-30). The bv_comp ladder on bvychs's six sign-switching types: -0.5 -> gap 0.000 (10 seeds), 1.2 -> +0.026 (10), 1.8 -> 0.000 (5), 2.5 -> +0.055 / +0.118 on the first two seeds (oracle room +0.15..+0.17 on six seeds, 63-84% of the linear ceiling; the type premium is monotone in b, so the room is cross-sectional nonlinearity in how the compensated characteristics map to b, not a hump). The response is non-monotone and the top is untested; this continues the ladder.

COST. The K4 pair sum scales with live projects, which stronger compensation multiplies: bvychs 22 GB, bvychs18 31 GB, bvychs25 ~9 s/month at 48 GB under the blocked K4 (commit 78961c4). Seeds requested at 80 GB.
